bio.text: Lee Johnson is serving his fourth term in the Arkansas House, representing District 47, which includes a portion of Sebastian County; the member page lists his address as Greenwood.
He is a physician with an M.D. from the University of Arkansas medical school and a bachelor's degree from Hendrix College.
He was elected to the Greenwood City Council, serving from 2008 to 2018, and has served on the State Board of Health.
